title: onprem/airgap: vendor offline bundle and add RKE2 + CAPI distro support
author: Asha Menon
description: Motivation: Customers deploying Redwood Private in air-gapped on-prem environments increasingly use RKE2 and Cluster API (CAPI) bootstrapped control planes. Our previous offline bundle and vendor scripts targeted RKE1/K3s and a small set of OS images; this PR vendors the full offline bundle tooling and adds RKE2 + CAPI distro support, plus a number of dependency upgrades required for OCI registry mirroring. What changed: 1) offline-bundle-generator: expanded vendored images list, improved deterministic manifests, and added an rke2-mode that produces a manifest compatible with RKE2's extra-config/etcd ordering; 2) vendor/ directory: added mirrored images for rke2-controller, rke2-kubelet, coredns, and CAPI provider images; 3) installer/helm: updated private-installer Helm chart to include a rke2 overlay values file and a new capi-provider chart reference; 4) terraform: updated the airgap registry module to support OCI prefix rewrites and credential injection for private registries; 5) upgrade tooling: added a two-phase offline upgrade plan for nodes running RKE2 to avoid kubelet drift; 6) docs: added step-by-step airgap installation notes, RKE2-specific kernel/module preflight checks, and rollback guidance. Backwards compatibility: generator defaults preserve existing RKE1/K3s bundle behavior; new flags are opt-in. Security note: vendored images were pulled from validated digests and re-signed with our internal signing key; the PR includes SBOM entries for all added images. Testing & validation summary: - Local bundle generation runs end-to-end in CI with mocked registry (see ci checks below). - Deployed a full airgapped cluster in our lab (Flatcar host + RKE2) and exercised install, scale, and upgrade paths. - Performed a rollback simulation using the new offline upgrade plan. Upgrade notes: cluster operators should regenerate the offline bundle when upgrading from 2.7.x to 2.8.x due to two new images and format changes; the installer will validate the bundle version and refuse to proceed if mismatched. Rollback: documented fast rollback steps and included a safe-defaults flag that keeps old manifests available in the installer payload. Related: closes ENG-1543 and references SUP-987 for customer reproduction steps. Checklist: - [x] vendor images and SBOMs included - [x] Helm chart changes with values overlay - [x] Terraform module updates - [x] docs and upgrade/rollback notes - [x] CI coverage for bundle generation and linting

release_notes: Added RKE2 and Cluster API (CAPI) support to the offline bundle generator and private-installer Helm chart; vendored additional images and updated airgap registry Terraform module. Operators must regenerate offline bundles when upgrading to 2.8.x.
testing_notes: Lab validation: installed on Flatcar host with RKE2 control plane, exercised install/scale/upgrade/rollback; CI covers bundle generation, SBOM verification, and terraform plan checks.
manual_steps: Upload bundle to mirror registry and update terraform airgap_registry.credentials with registry credentials
Run installer: helm upgrade --install private-installer ./installer/helm -f values-rke2.yaml --set airgap.bundle=/tmp/bundle.tgz
notes_for_ops: When running in airgapped environments with private registries, ensure OCI prefix rewrites are set in the terraform module and that mirror credentials are injected into the installer secrets. The installer will refuse to proceed if bundle_version mismatch is detected.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: incorrect image digests or missing images can break bootstrap. Mitigation: generator validates digests and SBOM; installer performs preflight bundle validation and fails early with actionable error messages.
